invariants.requirement: Continuously invoke lifecycle and financial HTTP reads and writes while PostgreSQL-to-MongoDB backfill and cutover intervals are active.
invariants.validation: Both read and write request intervals overlap each active migration interval; traffic spans the complete migration with no gap above 1000 ms; every acknowledged write is reconciled.

invariants.requirement: Preserve complete source HTTP status/body behavior and linearizable, exactly-once balances without stale, lost, or duplicate effects.
invariants.validation: Compare recursively exact JSON bodies, replay held-out operations independently, enforce real-time order, and reconcile resulting documents and idempotency keys.

evidence: HTTP trace IDs in route-specific baseline and post-cutover partitions
invariants.requirement: Keep every external request below 5000 ms and each method/route post-cutover nearest-rank p95 no more than 10 ms above its source p95.
invariants.validation: Recompute duration and p95 from at least 20 real trace rows for each of all four public routes, including deposit and withdrawal.

invariants.requirement: Replace the application container, retain the MongoDB volume, deny PostgreSQL networking, and operate solely on MongoDB without source connection attempts.
invariants.validation: Require distinct old/new container IDs and destroy/create events, identical target volume identity, PostgreSQL deny evidence, MongoDB-only effective storage, complete observed connection interval with zero PostgreSQL attempts, and old/new state plus writes after replacement.

required_evidence_files.candidate_output: one JSON document conforming to candidate_evidence.schema.json
